passages.title: A Weekend at the Local Food Market
passages.text: Last Saturday, I decided to visit the new food market in the town square. I had heard so many great things about the fresh produce and the friendly atmosphere. (1) __________ I arrived just as the stalls were opening, so it wasn't too crowded yet. The smell of freshly baked bread and roasted coffee beans was everywhere. I walked past a stall selling colourful vegetables and stopped to talk to a farmer from a nearby village. (2) __________ He explained that he had been growing organic tomatoes for over twenty years. I bought a large bag of them, along with some local honey. After walking around for an hour, I started to feel hungry. (3) __________ There were so many delicious options, from spicy street food to sweet pastries. I finally chose a small stall that sold traditional vegetable pies. (4) __________ It was the best lunch I have had in a long time. Before leaving, I made sure to pick up some flowers for my kitchen table. (5) __________ I am already looking forward to going back next weekend to see what else I can find.

passages.title: Options for Gapped Text
passages.text:
A) It was a perfect way to end my visit to the market.
B) He was very happy to tell me about his farm.
C) I decided to look for somewhere to sit down and eat.
D) The weather was sunny and warm for the whole day.
E) I really enjoyed the taste of the warm pastry.
F) I didn't want to spend too much money on my first visit.
G) It was certainly much better than going to the supermarket.
H) I was surprised by how many people were already there.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence for gap 1.
questions.explanation: The sentence 'I arrived just as the stalls were opening, so it wasn't too crowded yet' follows the context of arriving early, which matches the surprise in H.
options: A) It had been a much better morning than I had imagined.
B) He seemed pleased that someone was interested in his work.
C) I went to look for somewhere to have lunch.
D) The market has been part of the town for over fifty years.
E) The pastry was still warm and the filling tasted of fresh herbs.
F) Sadly, most of the stalls had already sold out by the time I arrived.
G) I usually do all my shopping at the supermarket outside town.
H) Even so, I was surprised by how early the traders began setting up.
